experiment: Hydrogen Stage 2 FGD pilots with relaxed nonmonotone line search
comparison_caveats: A different completed step count means the final checkpoints do not have equal update budgets.
The pilot changes learning rate, line search, and clipped functional-gradient centers; comparisons to older runs cannot isolate one change.
Fixed-grid FGD remains an approximate functional-gradient method with the same line-search safeguard.
The single held-out condition is used for reporting, not checkpoint selection.
Evaluation solves are capped at max(50000, training RHS cap); failures are reported per split/solver.
Resume timing excludes original-process work after the source checkpoint, and trial-failure counts cover saved update records only.
The pilots overlapped on the same machine; elapsed times are not an isolated speed comparison.

resume_from.note: timing excludes work after the source checkpoint; solve-work cap may differ

runs.training_timing_scope: initial train/test evaluation, training updates, post-update train/test evaluation, and per-step logging; excludes setup and final artifact serialization; a running update completes before the budget is checked again
runs.functional_input_coordinates: clamped to [-1,1] for both evaluation and gradient samples
runs.solver_trial_failure_count_scope: Failures recorded inside saved update records; a final rejected/interrupted update may have no saved trial diagnostics.
notes: Recorded timing includes the source checkpoint's elapsed offset and the resumed run, but excludes work after that source checkpoint in its original process.
Reported MSE and conservation penalty are averaged over time points; recorded_metrics and source histories retain the original training reduction. Rescaling a report does not retrain the saved model.
